verdict.rationale: Kimi members get a documented Kimi Code API that is compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, with API keys created in the Kimi Code Console. A separate Kimi API Open Platform also exists. However, the probe found no public API for the Kimi assistant app itself, so its features (agent mode, deep research, PPT, scheduled tasks) can't be driven programmatically, and the full API is a separate pay-as-you-go product. Community reports also note inflexible API parameters (fixed temperature and reasoning effort, no public image URLs). Missing for 10: a public API for the assistant app's agentic features, an API index for the assistant (kimi.com has no llms.txt), and flexible, production-ready API parameters.
